title: Audit P104 relay floor with an explicit monotone-lifetime model
head: 2704eadf6b5205d4b965e9c6fc6dce28b89783cf
body:
Philippe Van Velzen's P104 correction screen reports a 208-helper floor, but using that number requires an explicit operation model and a distinction between helper lifetimes and simultaneous storage. This independent audit supplies a relay-safe proof and source-bound certificates for that implication. It credits the numerical floor to the [original screen](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18939575), pinned at `7dfc7a176d7de4e7eabaf553a0b187c1bd647546`.

For each of 104 distinct terminal frames, the residual correction-source labels have binary rank eight, forcing at least two first arrivals from proper subspaces. One nested helper lifetime cannot visit two different terminal frames. This proves **at least 208 monotone helper lifetimes** with arbitrary same-frame linear relays, cancellation, independent dirty inputs and retiming preserving the source/target frame paths. It does not prove 208 simultaneous registers or an attaining construction.

The six-file package adds a written proof, eight-label rank witnesses and two-hyperplane covers for all 104 targets, an independent standard-library verifier, exact source pins and an opt-in replay hook. Two concrete boundary examples prevent overgeneralization: two arrivals may merge into one target writer, and the retained private descent at cut 2464 carries `X8` with coefficient `-2` into a frame excluding its label. Reusing the channel's descending/private values therefore changes a necessary premise.

Validation on macOS arm64:

- Registered CPython 3.12.14 replay and optimized CPython 3.14.7 replay passed; seven semantic/control groups.
- A separate AI-assisted implementation matched every target residual set and cover; a separate proof/model review found no blocking issues.
- A Git-free export passed optimized replay without changing any file. Modified source/receipt inputs and an occupied output path rejected.
- Metadata/source pins and `git diff --check` passed.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-monotone-relay-floor-audit
python3 -I -O -B research/p104-monotone-relay-floor-audit/verify.py
```

Scope remains a restricted logical lower bound. No native phase/full-channel replay, simultaneous-stock theorem, correction circuit, pricing interval, complete moment, global hosting, precision/tape, all-size admission or new κ is claimed. The two-hyperplane covers establish a geometric minimum, not global attainability. Selected/frozen files are unchanged; hosted CI is separate.

Base and refreshed canonical main: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Single chooser nonce `a71071a87492501cab47b3076ccee844`, complex-mechanisms / p104-side-correction; changed scope to a defined audit obligation. Final overlap refresh covered 561 open PRs and 1,073 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings, followed by a focused monotone/relay screen. This is distinct from the active early-prefix dimension and 41-contact chronological-lift tasks. Historical #1238 concerns the selected 112-port word's end caps, rather than this P104 correction model.
